div.div:
1. A crop alert moves the plot to precision mode; closed or closed_without_fumigation return it to area mode (ADR-002).
2. Only a Federation agronomist with fresh MFA authorizes an order; the authorizer is never the pilot; no trigger authorizes.
3. An order closes only after the verification result; objects without a grant are quarantined.
4. Solid = normal progression; dashed red = timeout, rejection or revocation; dashed green = direct or late recovery; thick border = terminal.
